mapper.select:
SELECT ep.* FROM t_exam_paper ep LEFT JOIN t_exam_paper_user epu on ep.id = epu.exam_paper_id LEFT JOIN t_exam_paper_department epd on ep.id=epd.exam_paper_id
and ep.deleted= 0 and #{now} <= ep.limit_end_time and ( (epu.deleted = 0 and epu.exam_paper_answer_id is null and epu.user_id = #{userId} ) or (epd.deleted = 0 and epd.department_id=#{departmentId})) and not exists (select 1 from t_exam_paper_answer epa where ep.id = epa.exam_paper_id and epa.create_user = #{userId})

SELECT epu.limit_start_time ,epu.limit_end_time , ep.* FROM t_exam_paper ep LEFT JOIN t_exam_paper_user epu on ep.id = epu.exam_paper_id
and ep.deleted= 0 and epu.exam_paper_answer_id is not null and epu.deleted = 0 and epu.user_id = #{userId} and #{now} <= epu.limit_end_time and not exists (select 1 from t_exam_paper_answer epa where ep.id = epa.exam_paper_id and epa.deleted= 0 and epa.create_user = #{userId})

SELECT id FROM t_exam_paper ep
and deleted= 0 and ep.id = #{paperId} and ( exists (select 1 from t_exam_paper_user epu where ep.id = epu.exam_paper_id and epu.user_id = #{userId} and epu.deleted = 0) or exists (select 1 from t_exam_paper_department epd where ep.id = epd.exam_paper_id and epd.department_id = #{departmentId} and epd.deleted = 0) )
limit 1
